    with ui.progress(desc="Building workspace index", unit="entry") as pb:
        workspace = build_data_index(
            repo.index,
            repo.root_dir,
            repo.fs,
            compute_hash=True,
            callback=pb.as_callback(),
        )

    with ui.progress(
        desc="Calculating diff between index/workspace",
        unit="entry",
    ) as pb:
        return _diff(
            repo.index.data["repo"],
            workspace,
            not_in_cache=True,
            callback=pb.as_callback(),
            **kwargs,
        )
